senses.def: A village in Kacha selrada, Bakhchysarai Raion, the Crimea, Ukraine.
A village in Novopokrovka settlement hromada, Dnipro Raion, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, Ukraine.
A village, the administrative centre of Osypenko rural hromada, Berdiansk Raion, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, Ukraine, founded by runaway serfs from the Poltava Governorate in 1805.
ex: Meronym: (former separate colony, now the village’s western part) Neuhoffnung

senses.def: A former silrada of Berdiansk Raion, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, Ukraine, amalgamated into Osypenko rural hromada in September 2016; administrative centre and sole constituent settlement: Osypenko.
